ValidationRule.description: A lead cannot be moved to Nurture or Disqualified without a Stage Reason.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Nurture"), ISPICKVAL(Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Disqualified") ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Stage_Reason__c)), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Lead_Automation) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pick a Stage Reason before moving a lead to Nurture or Disqualified.
